title: Puerto Rico wins Miss Universe 2026; PH's Bea Millan-Windorski in 3rd place
summary: Puerto Rico emerged as the winner of the 75th edition of Miss Universe in Puerto Rico on Tuesday, November 24 (Wednesday, November 25 in the Philippines).
